text.title: Design System Changelog Template Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes on whether the release is a versioned package with external consumers, then on the highest change class in it, to decide between skipping, halting for migration anchors or visual evidence, and writing the full changelog entry set.

decision-tree.root-question: Is this release published as a versioned package that at least one team outside the system's own repository installs?

branch.when: the system is consumed from source inside the same repository by a single surface

conclusion.verdict: skip; the git log already is the changelog for a single in-repo consumer

branch.when: no versioned release scheme exists yet — nothing is published with a version number

conclusion.verdict: skip; route to design-system-governance to establish a release and version scheme, then return

branch.when: the release is documentation-only with no package version change

conclusion.verdict: skip; no consumer-observable impact to publish

branch.when: a versioned package with external consumers is being cut
branch.question: What is the highest change class in the release, as assigned by the breaking-change classification?

branch.when: at least one entry is classified MAJOR
branch.question: Does every breaking entry resolve to its own guide anchor (URL plus fragment) carrying a before/after snippet and the codemod invocation where one exists?

branch.when: one guide URL covers several breaking changes, or an anchor has no before/after snippet

conclusion.verdict: halt the release note; write a per-entry anchor for each item in breaking_changes before publishing

branch.when: anchors resolve per entry, but the release contains a non-revertible step — a token store migration, a persisted user preference, a published Figma library update

conclusion.verdict: apply, but replace the version pin with a named forward-fix path and state the non-revertible step explicitly

branch.when: anchors resolve per entry and every step is revertible

conclusion.verdict: apply the full methodology; the published package version bumps MAJOR even where every other entry is a patch, and rollback_plan names the exact prior version to pin

branch.when: no MAJOR entry, but at least one entry changes rendered output without changing the API
branch.question: Is a visual-diff build referenced (Chromatic or Percy build id, or a Playwright screenshot run id) naming the affected component and token pairs?

branch.when: no visual-diff build exists for the changed components

conclusion.verdict: halt; run visual regression and attach the build id — risk_level for such entries must not be LOW

branch.when: a visual-diff build id and the affected component/token pairs are available

conclusion.verdict: apply the full methodology; MEDIUM risk by the published rule, impact field states the rendered delta a consumer sees

branch.when: the release is additive or fix-only — no MAJOR entry and no change to rendered output

conclusion.verdict: apply the reduced set; each entry still carries what/why/impact/migration/risk, with impact written as what the consumer sees rather than what was refactored
